text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Track and Field Meet 
approaching, I saw them during lunch—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! Carrots are delicious today too~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
After this I'll have some carrot ice 
cream~, and tonight I'll eat lots of 
carrots too~—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hold it, Urara-san! No matter how you look 
at it, you're eating far too much!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think so? I always eat about this 
much, though?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... You are always like this... Have 
more awareness of being the roommate of a 
first-rate lady...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're right! King-chan is amazing, after 
all! I've gotta learn from you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*Ahem*. In light of your keen eye, I 
shall recognize you as semi-first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
HOW・EVER! That is precisely why you must 
properly pay attention to weight control!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait... control...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For a first-rate lady, managing 
one's weight to maintain condition is 
second nature!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore! The Track and Field Meet is 
right around the corner! You are far too 
careless about these matters!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... Maybe King-chan has a point, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I think eating lots of things you 
love gives you way more energy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even if you do weight control, you can't 
run if you're not full of energy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Honestly, you really are...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Though, perhaps that carefree nature is 
something I ought to learn from.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may, I cannot help but 
worry... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...! King-chan, wait for 
meee~...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shall not! I have graciously granted you 
the privilege of running with this King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Stop whining and run off every single 
calorie you consumed!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'm with King-chan, after all! I'll 
do my very best!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Now, keep your head up! 
We will keep running without pause!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it! Keep my head up, right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uryaryaryaryaryaryaaaa~~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You fool! I didn't say stare at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That afternoon, the two of them happily 
ran laps until the very last minute the 
track was available.
